text:
SHARPENED, and correcting my own advice on this bead.

I said the Rd examples could be lifted from the README because it "already contains a runnable sequence". I executed every code block in the README to check that, and it is only partly true.

README: 11 r blocks. 1 install (skipped), 7 execute cleanly, 3 FAIL - and all three fail on undefined placeholders rather than on broken code:

  block  9  lm_extractor(...)      object X not found
  block 10  lm_relation_fit(...)   object response_runs not found
  block 11  plan_crossnobis(...)   object fit not found

Those are illustrative snippets showing API shape, which is a legitimate documentation style. But they are exactly the three raw-data ENTRY points, so they cannot be lifted into Rd examples - they are not self-contained. My earlier advice holds for the 7 blocks starting from precomputed effect matrices and not for these three. Those need writing.

THE SHARPER FINDING, from checking the vignettes as well

  introduction.Rmd   lm_extractor appears in ONE chunk, and that chunk is eval=FALSE (line 347)
                     lm_relation_fit appears only in prose (line 357)
  evidence-pairing.Rmd   neither appears
  BOTH vignettes         crossnobis appears ZERO times

So the raw-fMRI entry path - response data through lm_relation_fit or lm_extractor - has no executable documentation anywhere. The README block is a placeholder, the vignette chunk is eval=FALSE, and neither function has an Rd example. Nothing in the repository executes that path outside the test suite.

And the crossnobis/learned-metric capability - Epics 5, 6 and 7, the work this whole rebuild was organised around - appears in neither vignette at all. It does have Rd examples (crossnobis.Rd, plan_crossnobis.Rd), which is the saving grace, but a reader following the narrative documentation will never meet it.

WHY THIS MATTERS FOR THE CRITERION AS WORDED: "runnable Rd examples cover the first user journey". The journey does not start at a precomputed effect matrix - it starts at response data. That entry is currently the least documented part of the package and the only part with no executable coverage in any medium.

SUGGESTION: one small self-contained raw-data fixture - simulate a design and a response matrix in a dozen lines - would serve three purposes at once: an Rd example for lm_relation_fit and lm_extractor, a replacement for the eval=FALSE vignette chunk, and the missing first-journey example. Write it once, reference it three times.
